_comment: nodemon's default watch is the whole working directory, which here is
server/. That directory also holds uploads/, where multer writes the
resume a user has just submitted. So every upload touched a watched file,
nodemon restarted the API mid-request, and the review that triggered the
restart died with a dropped connection — the harder to spot because it
only happens on the one path that writes to disk.
Watching src/ alone fixes that: uploads/, migrations/ and scripts/ all sit
outside it, and none of them is code the running server reloads anyway.
The delay coalesces the burst of change events an editor emits when it
saves, so one save is one restart.
